result.summary: Test design for TNT-01, TNT-02, TNT-03, TNT-04 validated — all MUST requirements have integration tests, fixtures use per-test UUIDs, tests clean up via defer, BPM_TEST_DB_URL absence causes a clear named error, no error.SkipZigTest on any MUST test, TC-TNT-04-04 exercises the WARN-vs-ERROR behavioral switch by setting migration_window_active TRUE/FALSE and calling auditPublicSchema in both phases, lint_test_isolation.py exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR findings.
